blocks.text: PANGLAO, Bohol— Senior education officials and heads of delegations from Asia and Europe gathered in Panglao, Bohol, on Tuesday for the Second Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) Senior Officials’ Meeting (SOM2), ahead of the 10th Asia-Europe Meeting of Ministers for Education (ASEMME10). The Philippines, through the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), is hosting the international gatherings from Nov. 24 to 26, bringing together education ministers, senior government officials and representatives of academic institutions to strengthen cooperation in higher education.
